Activity 5: Escape Room Challenge
  - Description: Small mixed teams work together to solve a series of puzzles and clues within a time limit to "escape" a themed room. Teams debrief afterward on which communication and decision-making strategies worked best.
  - Objective: To strengthen collaboration, communication, and collective decision-making under pressure.
  - Location: To be determined (local escape room venue)
  - Date: To be determined
  - Time: To be determined (approx. 1.5 - 2 hours)

Activity 6: Community Volunteer Day
  - Description: Team members volunteer together for a local community project, such as a food bank shift, park cleanup, or tree planting. Teams reflect afterward on what they learned about working together toward a shared goal.
  - Objective: To build team morale and shared purpose while giving back to the community.
  - Location: To be determined (local nonprofit or community site)
  - Date: To be determined
  - Time: To be determined (approx. 3 - 4 hours)
